bedrockminer.config.toggle_enabled.comme: Toggle the Fabric Bedrock Miner on/off
bedrockminer.config.approach.comment:
Bedrock Breaking mode.

§aVanilla Fast§r: works on vanilla, fast, but can only break bedrock from up to down,
or from down to up.
§aVanilla All Direction§r: works on vanilla, can bread bedrock from all
direction, but speed is limited by server's syncing
player's yRot and yHeadRot speed.
§aCarpet Accurate§r: for server installed Carpet Extra and
with accurateBlockPlacement enabled, you can use this
mode to break bedrock from all directions very fast

bedrockminer.config.automine.enabled.com:
Toggle Auto Mine on/off.
While on, the mod keeps breaking the target blocks (bedrock by default)
inside the box between §aPos1§r and §aPos2§r without you clicking on them.
Only blocks you can actually reach are mined, and the box is never left.
Turning this on also turns on Fabric Bedrock Miner.
bedrockminer.config.automine.pos1.commen:
First corner of the auto mine box (format: x,y,z).
Click the §eSet here§r button next to the field to use your current position.
bedrockminer.config.automine.pos2.commen:
Second corner of the auto mine box (format: x,y,z).
Click the §eSet here§r button next to the field to use your current position.
bedrockminer.config.automine.target_bloc:
Blocks Auto Mine looks for inside the box
(e.g. §lminecraft:bedrock§r or §lBedrock§r).
Unbreakable ones use the piston method, others the pickaxe.
Server allow/block lists still apply.
bedrockminer.config.automine.skip_blocks: Never auto mine blocks you are standing on or inside
bedrockminer.config.automine.scan_interv: Ticks between scans of the box for reachable target blocks
bedrockminer.config.automine.max_concurr:
How many blocks are mined at the same time (drag the slider).
At §a1§r blocks are broken one by one; at e.g. §a10§r or §a20§r that many
piston setups run side by side inside the box. Higher values need
more pistons/torches on hand and are more visible to anti-cheat.
bedrockminer.config.automine.fail_cooldo:
Ticks to wait before retrying a block that could not be broken
(no valid approach, or the breaking attempt failed)
bedrockminer.config.automine.show_box.co:
Render the auto mine box whenever Pos1/Pos2 are set,
even while Auto Mine is toggled off. Turn off to hide the box.
bedrockminer.message.automine.no_area: Auto Mine is on, but Pos1/Pos2 are not set yet.
bedrockminer.config.automine.launch_dela:
Ticks to wait between starting two piston setups (20 ticks = 1 second).
§a0§r starts as many as allowed in the same tick; higher values stagger
them one by one, which looks more natural and spreads out the work.
bedrockminer.config.automine.max_range.c:
Maximum distance (blocks, from your eyes) at which Auto Mine picks targets.
The survival reach limit is §a4.5§r; keeping this lower leaves room for the
piston and torch, so setups are not placed at the very edge of your reach
and then abandoned.
bedrockminer.config.automine.box_fill_co:
Fill color of the auto mine box faces (first two hex digits = opacity).
Set the opacity to §a00§r to only draw the outline.
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.started: Automation started: mine → collect drops → move on. Stop with /bedrockbreaker automate off
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.no_area: Pos1/Pos2 are not set — set the auto mine box first.
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.aborted: Automation stopped (mod toggled off or player unavailable).
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.out_of_it: Automation stopped: out of required items (pistons/torches/support blocks).
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.done: Automation finished — the box is clean.
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.done_skip: Automation finished — %s block(s) could not be reached or broken.
bedrockminer.config.tool_protect.comment:
Never use a nearly broken tool. When the pickaxe in use drops to the
threshold, the mod switches to another one and fully blacklists the worn
tool; if no healthy Efficiency V pickaxe is left, the mod pauses and says so.
bedrockminer.config.tool_protect_thresho:
Remaining durability at (or below) which a tool counts as nearly broken
and is never touched again (drag the slider).
bedrockminer.message.tools_worn: §cAll usable pickaxes are at ≤%s durability — paused to protect them. Add a healthy Efficiency V pickaxe to continue.§r
bedrockminer.message.autopilot.tools_wor: Automation stopped: every usable pickaxe is nearly broken. Add a healthy Efficiency V pickaxe and run /bedrockbreaker automate on again.

bedrockminer.config.automine.clear_all_b:
Also mine §eevery other breakable block§r inside the box with the pickaxe
(deepslate, tuff, netherrack, ...). Bedrock and other unbreakable targets
still use the piston method. Liquids are ignored.
bedrockminer.config.automine.overlay_lin:
Line thickness of the automation overlay (routes, outlines, rings) —
drag the slider.
bedrockminer.config.auto_eat.comment:
Keep hunger near full. When it drops 3 bars below full, pause (after
running piston setups finish), eat from the inventory back to full
(golden carrots preferred, junk food never), then continue.

bedrockminer.message.autopilot.stuck: Automation stopped: trapped with no way to pillar out. Come rescue the player.
